svg.text: Every SA is scoped to its job: the detector may only touch the finops dataset, the cost-anomalies topic and project-level metric/log writes;

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the scheduler may only invoke this one job. No service-account keys anywhere. No project-level owner/editor role held by any of them.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BigQuery billing export only starts populating once enabled — a fresh project has no history to detect anomalies against.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: synthetic_billing_export is a clearly-labelled synthetic seed table (is_synthetic = true on every row) with 3 deliberately injected anomalies.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pointing SOURCE_TABLE at a real billing-export table instead is a one-line config change (docs/runbooks/02) — nothing else in this diagram changes.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cloud Scheduler calls the Cloud Run Admin API to start the job, authenticating with its own service account's OAuth token

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The job queries daily cost grouped by service, SKU and GKE namespace cost-allocation label

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each series is evaluated against its own 14-day trailing baseline (z-score, falling back to % deviation for flat series); flagged days are written to the anomalies table

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every flagged anomaly is published to Pub/Sub for downstream consumers

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The job also emits one structured JSON log line per anomaly to stdout

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A log-based metric counts those log entries

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An alert policy fires on the metric and notifies the email channel — a second policy alerts if the job itself crashes

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The job writes two custom Cloud Monitoring metrics (daily spend total, anomalies this run) that the dashboard charts

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Terraform-managed Billing Budget alerts the same channel at 50/90/100% of the monthly amount
